title: Apply for a security master licence
summary: Find out the requirements and steps for applying for a security master licence for a business.
intro:
Any business that employs or subcontracts people to carry on defined security activities (unless exempted by security industry legislation) must hold a master licence. A master licence can be held by an individual, a corporation or a government agency.

If you're a sole trader master licensee and you're carrying on the security activities yourself, you must also hold a Class 1 or Class 2 security operative licence.

### Master licence classifications

Master licences are classified into subclasses that authorise the number of licensed security operatives that may be provided under that licence, on any given day.
who_can_apply: Be a fit and proper person.
Hold a current ABN (ABNs issued to a trust are not acceptable).
Consent to having your fingerprints taken.
Not have been found to be bankrupt or insolvent, or had your business subject to a winding up order.
To be eligible for an individual master licence, or to be the nominated person for a corporation or government agency master licence, you must meet the requirements listed on the page.
what_you_need: Your personal details (as an individual sole trader, or as the nominated person if applying for a corporation or government agency).
Two proof of identity documents (one must contain your photograph and may require certification).
A current credit card and sufficient funds for fee payment.
The registered business name you wish to trade under (unless you are a sole trader and do not trade under a business name).
For each close associate, a completed Close Associate nomination form – PDF.
Public liability insurance cover of at least $10,000,000 if providing security activities involving firearms, horses, or dogs.
Full Australian birth certificate, or Australian citizenship certificate, or Australian passport.
A foreign passport (original certified copy) and your visa grant notification letter.
A police certificate from each country (other than Australia) lived in for 12 months or more over the previous 10 years since turning 16 years of age.

how_to_steps.text: Gather all your digital and scanned documentation.
Do not start this application process unless you have all the necessary attachments. You cannot make any changes after you've submitted.
Check you meet all the eligibility requirements.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.

enter your name in the Last Name field.

A master licence is not transferable.
The people who are employed or subcontracted under the master licence must hold Class 1 or Class 2 security operator licences.
If your application is incomplete, or you fail to provide the required information, your application will be delayed and may be withdrawn.
If your application is withdrawn, you'll receive a refund of fees paid minus the processing fee. After a licence has been issued, there is no provision for a refund of fees.

faqs.q: Who must hold a master licence?
faqs.a: Any business that employs or subcontracts people to carry out defined security activities (unless exempted by security industry legislation) must hold a master licence.

faqs.q: What is required if I am a sole trader master licensee and perform the security activities myself?
faqs.a: You must also hold a Class 1 or Class 2 security operative licence.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply for a master licence?
faqs.a: You need personal details, two proof of identity documents, a current credit card, your ABN, the registered business name, and potentially forms for close associates.
